page_title: FUL 3-1 BUR | Fulham v Burnley 21/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+8' What a chance that is! Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
90+5' 3 - 1 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes the penalty and perfectly sends the ball inside the left post.
90+5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

90+3' Josh Laurent (Burnley) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and the referee shows him a deserved red card! PENALTY to Burnley! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
90+2' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alex Iwobi (Fulham) receives a yellow card.

90+1' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Raul Jimenez (Fulham) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' A cross from a corner kick by Burnley is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
87' Here is a change. Harry Wilson is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Harrison Reed (Fulham).
87' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kyle Walker walks off the pitch to be replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Burnley).
85' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
82' Burnley take a short corner kick.

82' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Bernd Leno sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. The ball is out of play and Burnley manage to earn a corner.
82' The substitution is prepared. Raul Jimenez (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo Muniz.
82' The substitution has been made. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) has replaced Joshua King.
80' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
78' Scott Parker has decided to substitute Lyle Foster and he is replaced by Marcus Edwards (Burnley).
78' A substitution has been made. James Ward-Prowse goes off and Ashley Barnes (Burnley) comes on.
76' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Bernd Leno makes a simple save.
76' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

73' 2 - 1 Goal! Joshua King displays great vision and sends a pass to Harry Wilson (Fulham), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 2:1.
73' Fulham enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Fulham comes to nothing.
67' 1 - 1 Goal! Joshua King (Fulham) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:1.
65' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
64' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Fulham, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
64' James Ward-Prowse (Burnley) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Fulham have a free kick.
61' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Oscar Bobb is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham).
61' Here comes a substitution. Antonee Robinson is given a rest as he is replaced by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
60' 0 - 1 Goal! Zian Flemming (Burnley) scores after an assist by Lyle Foster that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.

58' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
56' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Burnley, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonee Robinson (Fulham) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. A free kick is awarded to Burnley.

52' A rebound falls to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

52' Joshua King (Fulham) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score low in the middle of the goal, but great anticipation by Martin Dubravka allowed him to make a comfortable save.
51' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
51' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
48' Fulham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

47' Oscar Bobb (Fulham) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+2' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Wonderful movement by Fulham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
40' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
38' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' The game has begun to heat up. Josh Laurent (Burnley) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
34' Quilindschy Hartman (Burnley) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

32' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham.
29' Wow, what an escape. Harry Wilson (Fulham) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
27' Harry Wilson (Fulham) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.

26' A sweet pass finds Harry Wilson (Fulham) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the left side of the goal. Martin Dubravka is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
26' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
25' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

23' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
23' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.

21' Zian Flemming (Burnley) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
20' Harry Wilson (Fulham) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
18' Problems for Scott Parker as Hannibal Mejbri is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) replaces him.
16' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

15' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
14' The foul by Josh Laurent (Burnley) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
13' Burnley failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Burnley are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.

9' A terrific piece of skill by Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) inside the box gives him a clear goal scoring opportunity, but his shot is blocked right on the line by a defender after the keeper was beaten.
7' Zian Flemming (Burnley) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
6' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
5' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

Burnley will kick the game off.
